INSERT INTO exentia.eventos_atribucion (booking_id, destino, tipo_evento, event_id, payload, response, status, retry_count)
SELECT
  b.id,
  'meta_capi',
  'Purchase',
  $1,
  $2::jsonb,
  $3::jsonb,
  CASE WHEN ($3::jsonb)->>'events_received' IS NOT NULL THEN 'sent' ELSE 'error' END,
  0
FROM exentia.bookings b
WHERE b.ghl_contact_id = $4
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
